description: The sample is weighed and mixed with fluxing agents to assist with melting and promote separation from waste (gangue) materials from the precious metals. After cooling, the gangue is separated and discarded as a glassy slag from the precious metal containing lead button. This button is further heated on an absorbing magnesium oxide crucible to remove the lead and trace amounts of base metals. A small silver prill is left containing the precious metals.
